$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A relay's hello
description: The first frame xenonet relay writes on its standard output: which XenoNet is talking, in which protocol, and what it will send.

protocol.description: The relay's protocol: a console refuses one it doesn't speak, naming the host's version

anyOf.description: A name someone chose, ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,31}$: never the machine's own name, which often holds a person's

id.description: What the host calls itself, or null when it hasn't been named

key.description: Made once, at random, by the host: it recognizes the host across renames and SSH aliases. It names the host and proves nothing; SSH does that

platform.description: process.platform on the host: darwin, linux, win32

now.description: The host's clock, as the hello leaves it

sinceMs.description: How far back the relay sends sessions, or null for all

detail.description: Whether live detail crosses, or only titles, states and counts
